WITH

),

    SELECT

    FROM delivered_orders do
    JOIN pizza_toppings_base ptb ON do.pizza_id = ptb.pizza_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        do.order_id,
        do.pizza_id,
        do.exclusions,
        ptb.topings_raw,
        split_part(replace(ptb.topings_raw, ' ', ''), ',', 8) as topping_id,

),
-- Filter out exclusions
with_exclusions_removed AS (
    SELECT at.*
    FROM all_toppings at
